items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Johnny Lindsay, the trombone player, yeah. He was playing the trombone.

ctx.x: Oh, Johnny Lindsay. Johnny Lindsay, yeah. Johnny Lindsay, the trombone player, yeah. He was playing the trombone. Where did Red Happy go after that band? Do you remember where he went? Let me see. Red Happy stood a good while with the lyric, with the John Robichoux band. I'm not mistaken. I believe he went from the band.
